name: brand-form-submit
gateway_reason: Public brand form answers (#4514): guests on buyer web and the link page are anonymous (a personal link token identifies them), an optional bearer identifies Explorer users; rate-limited per salted IP hash, service-role DB access only through brand_form_submit_core. Wave 3: the link page's one-time code (code_begin / code_verify) sends through the existing email sender and SMS verify service claim-contact (#4063) already uses; no new secret. Wave 5: purchase_link mints the buyer's own after-purchase form link, proven by the checkout session's buyer status token (SHA-256), never an invite; checkout_form is the buyer checkout's form read under the same visibility rule as the server check, taking the same credentials as ticket-checkout-create (optional bearer, private ticket link HMAC-hashed with the existing OFFERING_INVITE_TOKEN_PEPPER).
